note: Images and model weights are not in Git. Every file is pinned by sha256; the benchmark refuses to report a complete result when one is missing or altered.

datasets.title: TRODO: A public vehicle odometers dataset for computer vision
datasets.citation: Mouheb K, Yürekli A, Yılmazel B. Data in Brief 38 (2021) 107321. doi:10.1016/j.dib.2021.107321
datasets.versionNote: v1 and v2 publish the same single archive (identical sha256); v2 adds the article link.
datasets.attribution: TRODO by Mouheb, Yürekli and Yılmazel, CC BY 4.0. Used unmodified for evaluation; derived crops and contact sheets are not redistributed.

archive.name: trodo-v01.zip
archive.verified: Downloaded 2026-10-31; size and sha256 equal the values the Mendeley public API publishes.

datasets.provenance: Smartphone photos from a delivery network in Turkey (cars and motorcycles), annotated in CVAT. No vehicle or session IDs are published.

contents.annotations: Pascal VOC 1.1 XML per image: odometer box, digit boxes 0-9, ',' and X (non-mileage characters)

datasets.labels: Mileage as the annotator read it. It does not distinguish trip meters from the odometer, and on analog registers it includes a differently coloured tenths drum inconsistently (see PROTOCOL.md 4 and 4a).
datasets.roles: benchmarks/scan/trodo-sessions.json (one line per image: split, group, family, role, sha256)
datasets.exclusions: excluded-label-check: digit boxes do not spell the label along any row (rolling drums, missing boxes). Unscored roles are reported, never pooled into the headline.

datasets.reason: No public dataset with numeric transcriptions was found. The candidates are Roboflow Universe projects whose download needs a signed-in Roboflow account, which this work cannot create or use. Their field boxes are not numeric ground truth.

candidates.labels: digit classes 0-9, dot, field boxes amount/litre (strings could be rebuilt from digit boxes)
field boxes only; augmented with horizontal flips

datasets.consequence: The pump real-world accuracy gate is incomplete. Pump behaviour is covered only by the synthetic mechanism suite.

datasets.reason: The two private photographs (CARE_PUMP_PHOTO, CARE_ODO_PHOTO) and the attached research package (report, dataset-sources.json, benchmark kit, price-prompt.txt) were not present on this machine.
datasets.consequence: The private-photo regression tests skip; that gate is incomplete. Prospective Israeli examples were not captured.

datasets.use: Mechanism checks only; never pooled with photographs.

models.configuration: WASM, one thread, no proxy, no WebGPU; SIMD required
